car_2014_04_003_powershell.label: CAR-2014-04-003 raw (PowerShell not from explorer)
car_2014_04_003_powershell.sql: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=1 AND (Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))

car_2014_04_003_powershell_tuned.label: CAR-2014-04-003 tuned (Office + encoded)
car_2014_04_003_powershell_tuned.sql: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=1 AND (Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentImage LIKE '%\\WINWORD.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\EXCEL.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\POWERPNT.EXE' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-EncodedCommand%' ESCAPE '\'))

car_2013_02_003_cmd_parent.label: CAR-2013-02-003 tuned (cmd from Office/reader)
car_2013_02_003_cmd_parent.sql: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=1 AND (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentImage LIKE '%\\WINWORD.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\EXCEL.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\POWERPNT.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\OUTLOOK.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\Acrobat.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\AcroRd32.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
